extras: Features a proposal review system for AI changes; requires external tools (yt-dlp, ffmpeg) for video transcription on desktop.
intentEvidence: Synapse is an Obsidian plugin that uses AI to help you build, maintain, and connect your knowledge base.
problem: Knowledge bases often contain incomplete, unlinked, or poorly structured notes that require significant manual effort to maintain and connect.
summary: Synapse is an AI-powered plugin that automatically elaborates, transcribes, enriches, summarizes, and organizes notes within a knowledge base.
